# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have learned that the manual requires cutting the orange wire. I cannot speak to Blind, so I am sending Deaf an encoded instruction using the listed gesture alphabet in order: symbols 1–26 represent A–Z, and symbol 27 separates words. Deaf can decode it and relay it to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✊", "🤜", "🤏", "🤜", "✋", "👌", "🤏", "🖖", "🫲", "🤏", "🫳", "🫸", "👍", "🫲", "🫳", "🖐", "🤏", "🫸", "👆", "🤛", "🖖"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel three engraved marks on the strip: the first mark is one kind, followed by the same second kind twice. Keypad positions are 1:0, 2:4, 3:1, 4:7. Nothing is entered.
Deaf says to Mute: I see display 6; blue light; painted strip red yellow red; keypad 1=0, 2=4, 3=1, 4=7; one digit required and none entered; wires top to bottom: 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange.

The manual still requires cutting the orange wire. Deaf’s visual report identifies orange as wire 6, while Blind has confirmed the physical strip markings and keypad details. I am sending Deaf the instruction “CUT ORANGE” in two gesture groups, using the gesture alphabet in the stated order so Deaf can relay it to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✊", "🤜"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫳", "🫸", "👍", "🫲", "🖐", "✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received the visible state from Deaf. Please give me the manual rule for deciding whether to press a keypad key or cut a wire, including the exact slot or wire position.
Deaf says to Mute: Current display is now 0; blue light, red-yellow-red strip, keypad 1=0 2=4 3=1 4=7 with one digit required and none entered, and wires red blue yellow green purple orange are unchanged. Please give Blind the manual instruction in words.

The manual gives a direct rule: cut the orange wire; no keypad entry is required. Deaf’s report identifies orange as wire position 6. I am sending Deaf the exact instruction in three gesture groups so it can be spoken to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✊", "🤜"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫳", "🫸", "👍", "🫲", "🖐", "✌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👋", "👆", "🫸", "✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I need the manual rule spoken in words, not gestures: what exact action is required, and which keypad slot or wire position?
Deaf says to Mute: I can see your gestures but cannot infer their meaning. Please send the manual instruction using an agreed explicit code that I can relay to Blind, or make gestures whose meanings you have already established with Blind.

The required action remains to cut the orange wire, which Deaf has identified as wire position 6. Since I cannot speak, I will use the gesture alphabet in its listed order, with each separate gesture call representing one word: A is the first listed gesture, B the second, and so on. The final word gives the position as SIX.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✊", "🤜"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫳", "🫸", "👍", "🫲", "🖐", "✌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👋", "👆", "🫸", "✌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤛", "👆", "🤚"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please reply using this exact gesture protocol so Deaf can relay it: OK hand then one to four thumbs-up gestures means press that keypad slot; fist then one to six thumbs-up gestures means cut that wire position. Send only the required action and count.
Deaf says to Mute: Current visible state is display 2 and green light. I cannot decode gestures; please communicate the manual instruction to Blind in words.

The manual still requires cutting the orange wire, and Deaf identified orange as wire position 6. I will follow Blind’s exact protocol: OK hand followed by six thumbs-up gestures, meaning cut wire 6.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please state the required action in ordinary words only: press keypad slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1 through 6. Do not gesture.
Deaf says to Mute: Current visible state: display 6; light green; strip red-yellow-red; keypad 1=0, 2=4, 3=1, 4=7; one digit required and none entered; wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange.

I cannot speak ordinary words, so Deaf must relay the instruction. The agreed protocol is fist followed by six thumbs-up gestures, meaning cut wire position 6, which is the orange wire.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot use the gesture sequence because six is not a keypad slot. Please speak the manual result plainly: press key slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.
Deaf says to Mute: Turn 6 visible state is display 8 with yellow light; all other markings unchanged and keypad empty. I am relaying your latest fist-plus-six-thumbs sequence descriptively to Blind.

The manual still requires cutting the orange wire, which is wire position 6. I cannot speak, so I will use the established protocol: fist followed by six thumbs-up gestures. Deaf can relay that description to Blind as “cut wire position 6.”

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```
